review_identity: Current-thread Astra advisor session /root/astra_planning. Not the historical Astra Main thread; no communication with that historical thread is claimed.
scope: Full text of the exact final introduction revision, numerical claims against accepted evidence and arithmetic, all nine local citations against primary sources, and an independent read-only recount of the historical R19 rows. This is not whole-thesis acceptance, exhaustive literature review, independent replication of all SI-U1 raw outputs, graduation approval, or authorization for a new evaluation.

separate_outline_and_defense_artifact.status: Previously written supervisor-discussion draft, unchanged during introduction review; no graduation guarantee.

resolved_issues: Expert-annotation savings are conditional; no claim that self-generated data necessarily reduce total cost.
ALE matched-step main-text statement is distinguished from appendix update/epoch descriptions and from total data-collection cost.
The decision rule, not the observed inconclusive outcome, is described as predeclared.
RQ2 covers the union of C−A and C−B disagreement tasks, rather than inaccurately describing all selected disagreements as B−C.
Agarwal’s few-run deep-RL caution is separated from this study’s additional task-population assumptions.

SI_U1.decision: INCONCLUSIVE under the predeclared rule; not equivalence, non-harm or efficacy. Paired task analysis does not estimate variation across independently trained checkpoints.

diagnostic_scope.fifty_action_failure_pattern: Accepted descriptive record supports the reported pattern; its cause is not established. Outcome-dependent selection is acknowledged.

R19_direct_static_recount.boundary: Hindsight on tested development paths; neither an online stopping rule nor a general population upper bound.

causal_and_generalization_boundaries: Matched family counts and supervised-token dose do not control task identities, encountered states, input-token totals or success-selection effects. Each continuation has one training seed. Identity/hash checks do not certify unseen scene layouts or eliminate historical exposure. The introduction retains these limitations.

citation_checks.location: Official ALFWorld paper, abstract and environment description
citation_checks.finding: Supports a text-based household-task environment. The draft does not equate its TRAIN schedule with the benchmark held-out split.

citation_checks.location: Qwen3 Technical Report, model architecture table
citation_checks.finding: Supports Qwen3-8B as the eight-billion-parameter dense model class. This source does not verify which local checkpoint was loaded.

citation_checks.location: AISTATS 2011 primary publication abstract and sequential imitation-learning formulation
citation_checks.finding: Supports dependence of encountered states on prior actions and distribution mismatch. It does not prove the cause of this project’s observed failures.
Directly supports expert initialization followed by action modeling on the agent’s own successful trajectories. These components cannot be claimed as novel here.

citation_checks.location: Primary ACL publication abstract; scoped claim only
citation_checks.finding: Supports self-generated reasoning/action trajectories and feedback-based reflection. The introduction makes no detailed algorithmic or quantitative comparison requiring a full independent implementation audit.

citation_checks.location: Self-generated example database; section 6.4 and Appendix C
citation_checks.finding: Supports both in-context use and fine-tuning with successful self-generated experience. It should not be described as prompting-only prior work.

citation_checks.location: Methods and experiments; dataset-scaling discussion with OEC plus BC mixtures
citation_checks.finding: Supports comparisons of expert, learner-generated and expert-corrected constructions in software-engineering agents. The final draft explicitly acknowledges expert-data mixtures; it does not call this a clean source-only causal comparison.

citation_checks.location: Early-experience objectives; main experiment text and Appendix B.2
citation_checks.finding: Supports expert-augmented experience supervision. Main text reports matched step budgets; Appendix B.2 states equal total updates for IWM and equal epochs for SR. The draft preserves that distinction and does not infer equal collection cost.

citation_checks.location: NeurIPS 2021 abstract and discussion of evaluation with few independent runs
citation_checks.finding: Supports caution about point estimates and uncertainty with few runs in deep RL. The draft separately states its own task-sampling and relatedness assumptions; it does not transfer a bootstrap guarantee to this fixed single-seed study.

actions: Read existing documents and historical JSONL; check hashes and simple counts; inspect primary publications; write this review only. No model, environment, recovery runner, training, candidate selection or new evaluation protocol was executed or designed.
remaining_editorial_work: Integrate local citation numbering into the thesis bibliography and obtain supervisor feedback on scope and institutional thesis requirements. No scientific claim revision is required by this bounded review.
